english.title: Fail to ensure poultry gas stunner at slaughterhouse correctly equipped and operated
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the business operator]_
(B)_[a person]_

engaged in the stunning of poultry by exposure to gas at a slaughterhouse at **(..SPECIFY SLAUGHTER HOUSE LOCATION..), failed to ensure that

(C)_[the gas stunner was equipped to maintain the gas concentration, as appropriate, in the gas stunner]_
(D)_[there was a means of visually monitoring poultry which were in the gas stunner]_
(E)_[there was a means of flushing the gas stunner with atmospheric air with the minimum of delay]_
(F)_[there was a means of access to any poultry with the minimum of delay]_
(G)_[no poultry were passed through or allowed to remain in the gas stunner at any time when the visible and audible warning signals had been activated or when there was any defect in the operation of the gas stunner]_
(H)_[no poultry were shackled before they were dead]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(c) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 30(3) of Schedule 1 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
